profile.details: The system correctly identified core profile elements (email, name, preferred name, languages, language variant, default tone, semi-formal greeting styles). However, several issues reduce quality: (1) The signature title was merged ('Chef de projet - Division Digitale') rather than keeping title and department separate as in ground truth. (2) Closing styles have notable errors: semi_formal_fr should be 'Merci,' not 'Cordialement,'; formal_fr should be 'Cordialement,' (correct but misassigned); semi_formal_en should be 'Best,' not 'Best regards,'; casual_fr should be '(no closing or just name)' not 'Sophie'. (3) The formal_fr greeting uses 'Madame {last_name}' instead of 'Madame/Monsieur {last_name}'. (4) Missing: uses_emoji field (false), casual_fr greeting style ('Salut {first_name},'), and the top-level 'addressing' field ('mixed'). (5) Added fields not in ground truth: 'profession', 'profession_confirmed', and 'addressing' nested inside tone (with incorrect value 'vous' vs ground truth 'mixed' at top level). (6) average_response_length is 'medium-long' vs ground truth 'medium'. These closing style errors are particularly impactful for email drafting usefulness.

knowledge.details: The system found all 13 ground truth contacts plus one hallucinated contact (support@cloudprovider.com). However, the output is missing several critical fields: 'type' (relationship type) is absent for all contacts, 'topics' are missing for all contacts, and most 'title' fields are null despite being known. Company names are often truncated/simplified (e.g., 'ClientCorp' instead of 'ClientCorp SA', 'Fournisseur' instead of 'Maintenance Pro SARL'). One tone is wrong: Amelie Petit is marked 'semi-formal' instead of 'formal'. Marc Dupont's title is given as 'CEO' instead of 'PDG'. The absence of relationship types (colleague, client, manager, direct_report, etc.) significantly reduces usefulness for email drafting, as tone and formality decisions depend heavily on this. Topics are entirely missing, which limits context for drafting. The hallucinated contact adds noise.

rules.details: The system found most contacts from ground truth (12/14 matched) and added 2 fabricated contacts (recrutement@techcorp.fr, it-support@techcorp.fr). Several tone classifications are wrong: pierre.durand should be 'casual' not 'semi-formal', camille.roux should be 'casual' not 'semi-formal', nicolas.moreau should be 'semi-formal' not 'formal', ceo@techcorp.fr should be 'semi-formal' not 'formal', elena.volkov should be 'formal' not 'semi-formal'. The general rules capture the spirit of most ground truth rules but lack the structured named rules format and miss specific triggers/actions. The system identified 10 general rules vs 8 in ground truth, with some useful additions (metrics, meeting slots, project references) not in ground truth but also missing the explicit 'cc_relevant_people' and 'action_items' rules. The forbidden_phrases match. Contact rules are mostly usable despite tone misclassifications, but the tone errors for internal contacts (Pierre, Camille) and Nicolas/CEO could lead to wrong formality in drafts.
